mapper.select: select cm.tenant_id as tenantId, cm.menu_id as menuId, m.parent_id as parentId, m.menu_name as menuName, m.menu_type as menuType, m.order_num as orderNum, ifnull(cm.status,'0') as status from hc_customer_menu cm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = cm.menu_id and m.menu_type in ('M','C') where IFNULL(cm.is_deleted,0)=0 AND cm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by m.parent_id, m.order_num
select menu_id from hc_customer_menu where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select menu_id from hc_customer_menu where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = '1'
mapper.update: update hc_customer_menu set is_deleted = 1, delete_by = #{auditDeleteBy}, delete_by_name = #{_auditDeleteByNameAuto}, delete_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from hc_customer_menu where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} and menu_id = #{menuId} and (is_enabled = '1' or is_enabled is null) and (status = '0' or status is null)
mapper.update: update hc_customer_menu set status = #{status} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hc_customer_menu (tenant_id, menu_id, status, is_enabled, create_by, create_by_name, create_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{menuId}, ifnull(#{status},'0'), ifnull(#{isEnabled},'1'), #{createBy}, #{createByName}, now(), 0)

insert into hc_customer_menu (tenant_id, menu_id, status, is_enabled, create_by, create_by_name, create_time, is_deleted) values
(#{item.tenantId}, #{item.menuId}, ifnull(#{item.status},'0'), ifnull(#{item.isEnabled},'1'), #{item.createBy}, #{item.createByName}, now(), 0)
